bug: The memory-window range check includes the window's end, so an address one byte past the window is accepted and remapped (off-by-one).
BoundField.legend_tag() mutates the caller's attrs dict.
After the backend reaches EOF, forwardTCP calls shutdown(SHUT_RD) on the backend socket, which fails with ENOTCONN on macOS (and on Linux in TIME_WAIT) and breaks every forwarded connection.
The new cascaded-PIC output IRQ is allocated but never freed (leak).
Emulating MOV r/m64, imm32 with a memory destination stores only the low 4 bytes of the sign-extended immediate.
The new tokenizer mis-parses comment and verbatim tags written without spaces.
Checksum-offload flags were dropped from the long-descriptor check, but they are written to the second descriptor, which only a long BD has, so checksum offload silently fails.
A non-compliant NBD client can trigger an assertion (server crash) by sending BLOCK_STATUS without negotiated metacontexts.
cluster_bytes and buf_bytes are int, which overflows for the largest allowed cluster size.
The PTE NR (not readable) bit is ignored, so write-only pages are exposed as readable.
The max_queue_size setter uses a uint64 visitor for a uint32_t field, accepting values that do not fit.
The counter pool name is freed on the create error path and again on destroy (double free).
The EEPROM dump stops at the first port whose module EEPROM cannot be read, hiding all later ports.
Reserving all VA space in one go places the first fbarray right after the memseg lists, which crashes secondary processes.
JSONField __in lookups crash on SQLite when the right-hand side holds Value(None) expressions.
get_prep_lookup() consumes iterator right-hand sides in annotation lookups, so the query sees an empty list.
The new route-MTU warning fires wrongly with portmap chaining, where cilium-cni still sets the route MTU.
`tetra tracingpolicy domains` accepts unsupported output formats, prints nothing and exits successfully.
Prefault workers are released before their threads finish starting up, a race that makes large prefaults up to 4x slower.
Removing `touch-action: none` from the draggable devtools indicator breaks dragging on touch screens.
